claim: pgmnemo 0.20.0 adds graph entity expansion (Variant C) and BFS causal expansion (Variant A) to recall_hybrid(), plus a retrieval_source TEXT output column. All new GUCs default to 0.0 (opt-in). At defaults, 0.20.0 produces byte-for-byte identical output to 0.19.1 — proven algebraically. No performance claims are made: the ablation study (PREREG_020_EXPAND, SHA 4eb3a2b8) is pre-registered and runs after this release.
criterion: At default weights (graph_expand_weight=0.0, graph_entity_expand_weight=0.0, graph_proximity_weight=0.0): all new CTEs short-circuit to empty sets via guards; candidate pool and scoring formula reduce to v0.19.1 identically; Δrecall@K=0.0 by algebraic proof.

Postgres skips recursive steps when seed is empty. Overhead is below noise threshold — same class as v0.19.0 latency note (guarded walk at weight=0.0, delta p50 -0.2ms). No latency regression expected.
